verdict.rationale: Netlify ships dashboard AI agents (netlify-docs-21), so asking whether those agents can use tools from external MCP servers is a fair question. However, the evidence never shows any way to plug MCP servers into Netlify. The 'connect AI assistants to your Netlify account' item (netlify-docs-22) describes outside assistants reaching into Netlify, which is the opposite direction and cannot be credited here.
